title: Train a 2-Layer MLP on XOR
signature: def train_mlp(X, y, W1, b1, W2, b2, lr, epochs) -> tuple
hints: Sigmoid plus binary cross-entropy cancel nicely: the gradient of the mean loss with respect to the output logit is (p - y) / N.
Backprop through tanh multiplies by (1 - h^2), where h is the tanh output.
Compute all four gradients from the current parameters before you update any of them.
Record the loss of the current parameters at the start of each epoch, then update.
